title: Sagas, per-player turn counter, card sweep
notes: Turn counter: each player's turns are counted separately. The top bar shows the current player's turn number (hover it for both), and the log and the YOUR TURN banner use it too.

Sagas: The Eldest Reborn's chapter III, Urza's Saga (gains its mana and Construct abilities, finds a {0}/{1} artifact), The Akroan War (the stolen creature goes back when the saga leaves, creatures must attack, tapped creatures damage themselves) and Elspeth Conquers Death (cost increase, counter on the returned card) now work.
"Gain control of … for as long as …" effects end when the source leaves the battlefield.

Card sweep over every sample and precon card (about 1,600 cards): fixed Avenger of Zendikar and other "create a token for each …" cards, Chaos Warp, Blink, Living Death, Teferi's Protection, Silence, Plaguecrafter, Goblin Dark-Dwellers, Soul of Windgrace, Puppeteer Clique, Mortuary Mire, Noxious Revival, Chittering Witch, Dire Fleet Ravager, Secret Rendezvous, Ox Drover, Smothering Tithe, Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Sanguine Bond.

title: Maelstrom Wanderer, Exotic Orchard, pain lands
notes: Maelstrom Wanderer cascades twice (it only cascaded once).
Exotic Orchard and Fellwar Stone only make colors your opponent's lands could make, and Reflecting Pool only what your own lands could make (they made any color before).

Pain lands (Battlefield Forge and friends), Talismans, horizon lands and Mana Confluence cost 1 life when they make colored mana. Paying for spells uses their painless colorless mana first when it can, and the log shows the life paid.
Miirym, Sentinel Wyrm: copies of legendary Dragons now show as nonlegendary on the card.
Checked: Repurposed Enforcer's Empower Jace X works (fixed in 1.2.13).

title: Spellbound Dragon
notes: Spellbound Dragon gets +X/+0 equal to the mana value of the card you actually discarded (it always got +0 before). Other "where X is the discarded card's mana value" effects are fixed too.

title: Bontu, Rakdos Charm, Empower Jace, Curiosity
notes: God-Eternal Bontu: sacrifice any number of other permanents, then draw that many (it drew nothing before). When it dies or is exiled it goes third from the top of your library, not on top.

Rakdos Charm: "exile all cards from target player's graveyard" exiles the whole graveyard, and "each creature deals 1 damage to its controller" works. The AI now picks the mode that fits the board instead of always destroying an artifact; the same smarter mode choice applies to every modal spell.
Empower Jace: puts loyalty counters on your Jace token, creating the blue Jace planeswalker token (−1: Surveil 1, −3: Draw a card) first if you don't have one.

Jace, Multiverse Architect: its combat trigger asks the opponent to pay {2} or be unable to attack your Jaces that turn; the −3 reveals until a creature or planeswalker and puts it onto the battlefield, the rest on the bottom.
"Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a … card" effects now work in general.
Curiosity, Ophidian Eye, Sigil of Sleep and other "whenever enchanted/equipped creature deals damage to an opponent" auras trigger, including on noncombat damage.
Checked: Amass works (creates the Army or grows the one you have).

title: Maximum hand size
notes: At the end of your turn, if you have more cards than your maximum hand size, you're asked which ones to discard (before, the game only mentioned it in the log).

Maximum hand size changes are counted for both players: Reliquary Tower, Thought Vessel and other "no maximum hand size" cards, "your maximum hand size is increased/reduced by N", and opponents' effects like Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur.

title: Spacecraft and a bigger turn banner
notes: Spacecraft: abilities under STATION 2+, 8+ etc. are only available once the ship has that many charge counters, whichever way the card text is written, and the ship becomes an artifact creature at its last threshold ("It's an artifact creature at 8+"), so it can attack.
A big "YOUR TURN" banner now fills the middle of the screen when your turn starts.

title: War Room
notes: War Room's draw ability now charges life equal to the number of colors in your commanders' color identity (it was free before).

title: AI uses X loyalty abilities
notes: The AI now uses planeswalker abilities with X in the cost. It picks X to match the job: exactly enough damage to kill your best creature it can reach (Chandra Nalaar, Sorin, Grim Nemesis, Chandra, Awakened Inferno), the X that wipes the most of your board for "each creature" effects, or as many tokens or counters as it can while keeping the planeswalker alive (Kasmina, Tibalt).

title: Giada, multi-token spells, planeswalker AI
notes: Giada, Font of Hope: each other Angel enters with a +1/+1 counter for each Angel you already control (it only ever gave one), and Giada's mana can only be spent on Angel spells.
Cards that make several different tokens at once (Trostani's Summoner and friends) now make all of them, not just the first.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World's +1 (and similar effects) turns the land into a creature.
Planeswalker AI: it weighs whether your creatures could kill its planeswalker and goes up in loyalty when it's in danger, instead of spending it down.
Checked and working: Verdant Sun's Avatar, Trostani, Selesnya's Voice, Trostani Discordant.

title: AI crewing
notes: Fixed: the AI tapped every creature it had to crew a vehicle, then attacked with almost nothing. It now taps only the creatures it needs, using ones that can't attack well (summoning sick, low value) first.
The AI no longer crews a vehicle that came in this turn and can't attack yet.

title: Ilysian Caryatid
notes: Ilysian Caryatid taps for two mana of one color while you control a creature with power 4 or greater (it only ever made one before).

title: Unnatural Growth and Ghalta
notes: Unnatural Growth doubles the power and toughness of each creature you control at the beginning of each combat. Other "double the power (and toughness) of …" cards work too.

Ghalta, Primal Hunger costs {X} less where X is the total power of your creatures (from your hand or the command zone). Other "total power" and "greatest power among creatures you control" amounts are counted too.

title: Floating mana
notes: Click an untapped land, mana rock or mana creature to tap it for mana: the mana goes into your pool (shown under your life total) and is spent first when you cast or activate something. Sources that make more than one color ask which color.
Clicked the wrong land? Click it again in the same step to untap it and take its mana back out of the pool.
Treasures and other sacrifice-for-mana sources are sacrificed when you tap them this way.
Mana still floating when the step ends empties from your pool, and the log tells you.

title: Dragonstorm Globe, Endless Ranks, Hit the Mother Lode
notes: Dragonstorm Globe: Dragons you control enter with an extra +1/+1 counter. The same fix covers Grumgully, the Generous, Metallic Mimic and other "each … you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter" cards.
Endless Ranks of the Dead: makes half as many Zombies as you control, rounded down (it made none before). Other "where X is half …" cards work too.
Hit the Mother Lode: creates tapped Treasures equal to the difference after discovering.

title: Rituals, chosen creature types, a choosier AI
notes: Rituals: Mana Geyser, Battle Hymn, Brightstone Ritual, Songs of the Damned, Rite of Flame, Irencrag Feat, Manamorphose, Mana Seism, Cabal Ritual's threshold and Jeska's Will now add the right amount of mana.
Mana permanents that tap for "one mana for each…" now count properly: Gaea's Cradle, Priest of Titania, Elvish Archdruid, Cabal Coffers. Black Lotus taps for three.

Herald's Horn, Vanquisher's Banner and other "As this enters, choose a creature type" cards ask you for a type (the AI picks its deck's most common one) and then work: cost reduction, anthem, card draw and Herald's Horn's upkeep reveal.

Smarter AI: it no longer casts spells whose targets don't exist (reanimating an empty graveyard, removal with nothing to hit), and it saves removal and burn for real threats instead of firing it at tokens, unless it's under pressure.
Chaos Warp and other "shuffle it into its owner's library" spells count as removal for the AI.

title: Patch notes and twelve more precons
notes: New: this patch notes window. It opens after the app updates itself; click the version number on the start screen to see it again.

Twelve new precons: Eternal Might, Squirreled Away, Graveyard Overdrive, Desert Bloom, Most Wanted, Deadly Disguise, Masters of Evil (Doctor Who), Virtue and Valor, Food and Fellowship, Growing Threat, Party Time and Buckle Up.

Fixed commanders: Yuma (Desert cards make Plants), Disa (Lhurgoyfs come back), Brimaz, Blight of Oreskos (proliferate after a Phyrexian dies), Davros (Dalek and villainous choice), Hazel of the Rootbloom (Squirrels copied twice), Kaust, Ellivere, Nalia de'Arnise (full party), Frodo (Ring-bearer draw).
Also fixed: "whenever a … card is put into your graveyard from anywhere" triggers (The Gitrog Monster, Centaur Vinecrasher, Titania).
Triggers whose condition isn't met no longer ask you to apply them by hand.

title: Mardu Surge, tokens that enter attacking
notes: New precon: Mardu Surge (Zurgo Stormrender).
Adeline, Hero of Bladehold, Zurgo and every mobilize card now create their tokens tapped and attacking.
Zurgo Stormrender's token trigger works: draw if the token was attacking, otherwise each opponent loses 1 life.
"Do X if … Otherwise, do Y" now checks the condition instead of doing both.

title: TMNT and World Shaper precons
notes: New precons: Turtle Power! (Leonardo, the Balance) and World Shaper (Hearthhull, the Worldseed).
Partner—Character select commanders can be paired with each other.
Fixed: Korvold's counter-and-draw, Mayhem Devil, Mazirek, Szarel, Splinter, Rat King, Heroes in a Half Shell, April O'Neil, Ray Fillet, Casey Jones, Omnath, God-Eternal Bontu.

title: Space Beleren
notes: Space sculptor works: creatures get alpha, beta or gamma sectors (shown as α β γ), and all three of Space Beleren's abilities work.

title: Foundations Commander precons
notes: The Precon tab has the five Foundations Commander decks.

title: Second screen
notes: Pop the AI's board out into its own window with the ⧉ Pop out button (desktop app 1.1.0 or newer).
Fixed: Otherworldly Journey, Eerie Interlude, Semester's End, Ghostway and other end-step returns; Oubliette; Teferi, Master of Time.

title: More sample decks
notes: Six new sample decks at Bracket 1, Bracket 4 and cEDH, grouped by bracket.
New Precon tab.

title: Blink effects
notes: Fixed: Cloudshift, Ephemerate, Brago, Oblivion Ring, Journey to Nowhere, Fiend Hunter, Detention Sphere; the AI picks sensible flicker targets.

title: Dragonstorms
notes: The Dragonstorm enchantments return to your hand when a Dragon you control enters.

title: Changelings
notes: Changelings such as Firdoch Core count as every creature type, so The Ur-Dragon and other Dragon cost reducers apply to them.

title: First update
notes: Fixed: Sunbird's Invocation, Faeburrow Elder, Archnemesis and a crash on some attack triggers.
